set.dl_workers_hint: per download · too high triggers Telegram FloodWait
set.default_poll_hint: minimum {floor} · random jitter added to protect the account
set.daily_budget_hint: 0 = unlimited · downloads pause until midnight once reached
set.history_limit_hint: completed records to keep · 0 = all (files always kept)
set.tg_dm_hint: DM each completed download to your own Telegram account
set.tmdb_intro: Required: series channels are mapped to their TVDB/TMDB/IMDb ids through TMDB, so Sonarr finds releases by id. Get a free key at themoviedb.org → Settings → API. It also adds higher-resolution artwork and backdrops.
set.tmdb_attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
set.arr_intro: Telegrarr is added to Prowlarr as a Newznab indexer and to Sonarr/Radarr as a SABnzbd download client. The Connect page registers it in one click; the values below are for doing it by hand.
set.downloads_dir_hint: Grabs land in <folder>/telegram/<tv|movies>/<release>/ — mount it at the same path in Sonarr/Radarr
set.standalone_hint: Scans auto-download every new item into the library paths (upstream behaviour). Off = Sonarr/Radarr decide what to grab.
set.tg_connected: Connected — Telegrarr is signed in to your Telegram account.
set.tg_not_connected: Not connected. Connect your account so Telegrarr can read your channels.
set.tg_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Telegram? Downloads stop until you reconnect.
set.proxy_intro: Route Telegram through a proxy when your ISP throttles or blocks Telegram data centers (fixes downloads that stall/fail on a specific DC). Supports socks5://, socks4://, http:// and mtproxy://<secret>@host:port.
set.proxy_set_placeholder: •••• (a proxy is set — enter a new URL to replace)
tgw.api_intro_after: → API development tools, then paste the two values below.
tgw.phone_intro: Enter your Telegram phone number with country code. Telegram will send you a login code.
tgw.code_intro: Enter the code Telegram just sent (check the Telegram app on your phone).
tgw.password_intro: Your account has two-step verification enabled. Enter your Telegram password.
tgw.done_body: Telegrarr is signed in and can now watch your channels.
